## Veeva Systems Inc. (VEEV) `[Software & SaaS]`
- Veeva announced that another **top-20 biopharmaceutical company** selected **Vault CRM**; the company said **14 of the top 20** biopharma companies have now selected the platform (Seeking Alpha).
- Veeva announced **Falcon Router**, an agentic solution for routing safety, quality, and medical cases, with early-adopter availability scheduled for **January 2027** (Zacks Equity Research).
- Veeva’s fiscal 2027 second-quarter results included **$928 million revenue**, **$2.35 adjusted EPS**, and raised fiscal 2027 revenue and profit guidance; the figures were reported as **$928 million versus $905 million consensus** and **$2.35 versus $2.22 consensus** (StocksToTrade).

## Atlassian Corporation (TEAM) `[Software & SaaS]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window

## Rubrik, Inc. (RBRK) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window

## Ingersoll Rand Inc. (IR) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window

## Illumina, Inc. (ILMN) `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`
- Illumina shares reached a **52-week high of $256.17** on September 23, 2026; no company-specific announcement explaining the move was identified in the available results (RTTNews).

## Eni S.p.A. (E) `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`
- Eni was among energy stocks benefiting from higher crude prices; **Brent November futures rose about 3.9% to $103.08 per barrel**, while the energy sector gained about **1.1%** on September 23, 2026 (CNBC).

## Thomson Reuters Corporation (TRI) `[Software & SaaS]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window

## Venture Global, Inc. (VG) `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window

## Devon Energy Corporation (DVN) `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`
- No major company announcement was identified on September 23, 2026; Devon’s move was attributed to higher oil-market sentiment and ongoing expectations surrounding post-merger execution and synergies from the **Coterra combination** (Quiver Quantitative).
- **Brent crude** rose about **3.9% to $103.08 per barrel**, and **WTI** settled up about **1.8% at $92.16 per barrel**, providing the reported sector driver for energy shares (CNBC).

## NN, Inc. (NNBR) `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`
- NN raised its 2026 net-sales outlook to **$470 million–$490 million from $460 million–$480 million** (Timothy Sykes).
- NN raised its 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to **$58 million–$68 million from $55 million–$65 million** (Timothy Sykes).

## Fastly, Inc. (FSLY) `[Internet & Platforms]`
- Fastly shares rose about **13%** after Wall Street firms assessed the company’s investor day held on September 22; management presented fiscal 2029 targets of **14%–21% revenue CAGR**, **20%–22% non-GAAP operating margin**, and **12%–15% free-cash-flow margin** (Seeking Alpha).
- **RBC Capital Markets** was cited in connection with the investor-day assessment; the available result did not specify a rating or price-target change (Seeking Alpha).
